name: make_sense_fullstack
author: Davy ROBERT
description: Makesense is an international community founded in 2010 that supports and brings together citizens, entrepreneurs and organizations to solve today's social and environmental challenges together. The aim is to develop a platform that will be internal to the association, and that will serve as a decision-making management tool, with a history and follow-up managed dynamically between users according to different statuses.

scripts.setup: npm i && husky init && npm --prefix ./frontend i && npm --prefix ./backend i
scripts.setup:prod: npm i && npm --prefix ./frontend i && npm --prefix ./backend i && npm run build:prod
scripts.build:fix: npm run fix && cd frontend/ && npm run build:localprod
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run dev" "npm --prefix ./backend run dev"
scripts.dev:host: concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run dev:host" "npm --prefix ./backend run dev"
scripts.preview: npm run build:localprod && npm --prefix ./frontend run preview
scripts.preview:host: npm run build:localprod && npm --prefix ./frontend run preview:host
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production concurrently -n front,back -c green,yellow -t "HH:mm:ss" -p "{name} {time}" "npm --prefix ./frontend run start" "npm --prefix ./backend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix ./frontend run test && npm --prefix ./backend run test
scripts.fix: npm --prefix ./frontend run fix && npm --prefix ./backend run fix
scripts.delete: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && cd frontend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && cd ../backend && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
scripts.update: concurrently -n current,backend,frontend -c green,yellow,blue "ncu -u" "cd backend && ncu -u" "cd frontend && ncu -u"
scripts.deploy: npx update-browserslist-db@latest && npm run build:prod && npm start

json-comments.tips: Please install the JsonComments plugin to enable commenting functionality for JSON files, see: https://github.com/zhangfisher/json_comments_extension

frontend/package.json.scripts.dev:host: Permet le "Hot Module Replacement" (HMR) pour un serveur de développement. Tester en temps réel.
frontend/package.json.scripts.preview:host: Pour prévisualiser la version de production construite
